title: 第一卷 第9章 因你太美第一卷 第10章 神秘失踪
slug: 百倍返还我家孽徒全是女帝转世
content_zh:
青云宫主峰廊下，秋风萧瑟，卷得枝叶簌簌作响。
赵谦负手而立，脸色阴沉得如同泼了浓墨。
他实在没有想到林枫竟然还会有起来的那一天。
灵根被废的林枫，沉寂了十年，就将灵根修复了，要知道修复灵根几乎是逆天而行，不仅如此，他还收了一个天才弟子。
巨大的落差，让赵谦心底的歹念疯狂滋生。
“凭什么！？”
赵谦压低声音，唇间挤出一句嘶吼，眼底翻涌着滔天的嫉妒与不甘。
若任由林枫成长下去，不出数年，此人必定重回元婴！
到那时，以林枫的性子，还有今日结下的嫌隙，第一个清算的，绝对是他赵谦！
一念至此，赵谦眼中杀机凛冽，心中已然有了一个毒计。
……
小竹峰。
林枫正立于峰顶青石之上，把玩着手中刚到手的天阶流云清霜剑。
“师尊。”
柳雨姝端着一壶温热的灵茶，轻步走到林枫身侧，乖巧垂首，“峰上风大，师尊歇息片刻吧。”
林枫收回长剑，举起茶杯一饮而尽：“无妨，趁热打铁罢了。”
柳雨姝乖乖颔首，眼底亮晶晶的。
就在此时，一道传音符倏忽划破小竹峰结界，落在林枫耳畔，响起赵谦故作平和的声音：
“林枫峰主，老夫知晓你灵根修复，心中颇为欣慰。昔日多有冒犯，皆是老夫眼界狭隘。
今日西郊断魂谷有魔修余孽作乱，老夫一人难以肃清，特邀你一同前往除魔，也算化解你我往日嫌隙，不知峰主可否赏脸？”

话音落下，传音符燃尽。
林枫眸底微光一闪，嘴角勾起一抹冷笑。
断魂谷。
青云山西郊绝地，谷内荒无人烟，最适合杀人藏尸。
魔修余孽？
纯属无稽之谈。
整个大楚魔道经十年前一战，早已元气大伤，现在怎么可能贸然出现在青云宫眼皮子底下？
这赵谦怕是想诱他到无人之地，痛下杀手。
人人都以为他十年来颓废麻木，只在意修炼。可昔日能被称为“东荒妖孽”的人，怎么可能是一个心思单纯之辈？
柳雨姝见师尊神色微冷，当即攥紧小手，低声提醒：“师尊，赵长老心怀不善，您别去！”
林枫抬手揉了揉她的头顶：“无妨。”
“既然赵长老诚心邀我化解恩怨，我若不去，岂不是扫了他的兴？”
他现在手握天阶神剑，借这个机会，正好可以活动活动筋骨！
“你留在峰中修炼，不许外出，为师去去就回。”
话音落下，林枫白衣翻飞，清霜剑御空而起，身形化作一道白虹，径直朝着西郊断魂谷掠去。
断魂谷内，阴风怒号，寒气刺骨。
谷内乱石嶙峋，草木枯败，连一丝活物的气息都没有。
林枫身形落地，白衣立在乱石之间。
他展开神识探查了一番，谷中空空荡荡，哪里有半分魔修气息？
别说魔修余孽，就连半分邪气、半点异动都察觉不到。

“林枫峰主倒是守信。”
阴冷沙哑的声音骤然从半空响起。
下一秒，一股杀气腾腾的浑厚剑气，就直直往林枫的方向袭来。
content_en:
Under the main corridor of Qingyun Palace, the autumn wind was bleak, making the branches and leaves rustle.
Zhao Qian stood with his hands behind his back, his face as gloomy as if he had splashed thick ink.
He really didn't expect that Lin Feng would get up one day.
Lin Feng, whose spiritual roots were destroyed, repaired his spiritual roots after ten years of silence. You must know that repairing his spiritual roots was almost against the will of heaven. Not only that, he also accepted a genius disciple.
The huge gap caused evil thoughts in Zhao Qian's heart to grow crazily.
"Why!?"
Zhao Qian lowered his voice, a roar escaped his lips, and his eyes were filled with overwhelming jealousy and unwillingness.
If Lin Feng is allowed to grow, he will definitely return to Nascent Soul within a few years!
By then, with Lin Feng's temperament and the rift established today, he will definitely be the first to settle the matter, Zhao Qian!
At this thought, Zhao Qian's eyes were filled with murderous intent, and he already had a poisonous plan in mind.
…
Xiaozhu Peak.
Lin Feng was standing on the bluestone at the top of the mountain, playing with the Heavenly Order Liuyun Qingshuang Sword he had just received.
"Master."
Liu Yushu held a pot of warm spiritual tea and walked lightly to Lin Feng's side. She bowed her head obediently and said, "The wind is strong on the peak. Master, please rest for a while."
Lin Feng retracted his sword, raised his tea cup and drank it all in one gulp: "No problem, just strike while the iron is hot."
Liu Yushu nodded obediently, her eyes sparkling.
At this moment, a transmission note suddenly broke through the barrier of Xiaozhu Peak and fell on Lin Feng's ears. Zhao Qian's pretending to be calm voice sounded:
"Master Lin Feng, I am very pleased to know that your spiritual roots have been restored. I have had many offenses in the past because of my narrow vision.
Today, there are remnants of demonic cultivators making trouble in the Broken Soul Valley in the western suburbs. It is difficult for me to eliminate them alone. I specially invite you to go with me to eliminate the demons. This can also resolve the old differences between you and me. I wonder if the peak master can give me a favor? "
The words fell and the transmission notes burned out.
Lin Feng's eyes flickered, and the corner of his mouth curled up into a sneer.
Broken Soul Valley.
The western suburbs of Qingyun Mountain are deserted and the valley is deserted, perfect for killing people and hiding corpses.
The remnants of demon cultivators?
It's pure nonsense.
The entire Da Chu Demon Dao Sutra had been severely damaged in the battle ten years ago. How could it appear under the nose of Qingyun Palace now?
Zhao Qian was afraid that he wanted to lure him to a no-man's land and kill him.
Everyone thought that he had been decadent and numb for ten years and only cared about cultivation. But how could a person who could be called the "Monster of the Eastern Wasteland" in the past be a simple-minded person?
When Liu Yushu saw her master's slightly cold expression, she immediately clenched her little hands and reminded in a low voice: "Master, Elder Zhao has evil intentions, please don't go!"
Lin Feng raised his hand and rubbed the top of her head: "It doesn't matter."
"Since Elder Zhao sincerely invites me to resolve the grudges, if I don't go, wouldn't it be a disservice to him?"
He now holds the Heavenly Divine Sword in his hand, and he can take this opportunity to stretch his muscles!
"You stay in the peak to practice. You are not allowed to go out. You can go back as a teacher."
As soon as he finished speaking, Lin Feng's white clothes flew up, his Qingshuang Sword rose into the air, and his body turned into a white rainbow, heading straight towards the Broken Soul Valley in the western suburbs.
In the Broken Soul Valley, the wind was howling and the cold air was biting.
The valley is full of jagged rocks, withered vegetation, and not even a breath of living things.
Lin Feng fell to the ground, standing in white clothes among the rocks.
He unfolded his spiritual consciousness to investigate. The valley was empty. Where could there be any aura of demonic cultivators?
Not to mention the remnants of demonic cultivators, not even the slightest evil spirit or the slightest movement could be detected.
"Master Lin Feng is very trustworthy."
A cold and hoarse voice suddenly sounded from mid-air.
The next second, a murderous and thick sword energy struck directly in Lin Feng's direction.
